Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.

Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.

You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What impact you will have

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

  • Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact

  • Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible

Why it's an exciting challenge

  • Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

  • Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

  • Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

  • Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.

What you'll own

  • The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off

  • Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it

  • Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else

  • Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why

     

What you'll do

  • Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on

  • Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions

  • Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass

  • Use product data to decide: which findings reviewers accept, reject or ignore, and why

  • Build on Alwin's shared platform capabilities, and raise dependencies with other teams early

  • Help sales and customer success decide which customers and statements FSS is ready for

  • Write clearly: decisions, specs, and requirements so the team can drive forward with clarity and speed

What you'll bring

Must-have:

  • Product management experience on B2B software where getting it right matters: audit, accounting, tax, legal, compliance or financial services

  • A strong business acumen and focus on business impact

  • Experience shipping AI, machine learning or document-processing features, and making their output something people can check

  • Comfort with data: you can read an error analysis, query your own numbers and spot a sample that isn't representative

  • A record of prioritising for a large user base with demanding customers and competing stakeholders both internal and external

  • Enough technical depth to make trade-offs with engineers on accuracy, data and architecture

Strong-to-have:

  • An audit or accounting background, or deep knowledge of financial reporting (IFRS, US GAAP, UK GAAP)

  • Creative mindset thinking beyond how problems are solved today to reimagine a future approach that drive productivity

  • Experience in agentic products, workflows and systems

 

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

  • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

 

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

 

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options.

Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture.

  • Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements.

  • Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches.

  • Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development.

  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare.

  • Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives.

  • Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development.

  • 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.

  • A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers.

  • Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus.

  • A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes.

  • Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus.

What success looks like in the first 6 months:

  • You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms.

  • Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals.

  • Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving.

  • Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition.

  • The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams.

  • You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness.

  • You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed.

Our current tech stack:

  • We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach.

  • Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python.

  • Our frontends are built with Angular.

  • We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability.

  • Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

Hi, we are Storyteq! Storyteq helps marketing and creative teams in top brands scale their creative production and gain control over their marketing campaigns. Through our platform, our clients streamline campaign workflows, automate their creative production through templates and AI, and activate engaging campaigns that go to market faster. We believe creativity takes time, but creative production shouldn’t. Since 2016 our mission has been to revolutionize the way creative assets are created and used. Magic happens when we let technology empower creativity. Our endless curiosity and relentless commitment to our customers lies at the heart of our problem-solving approach. This shared mission is woven into our values: we dream big, think differently, and are stronger together.

About the job:

About the job You will be part of the Templating domain, where we enable global enterprises to scale up their content creation efficiently. Content comes in from sources like Photoshop, Figma and After Effects, or is designed in our AI-enabled, web-based editor, and then taken to the next level. You will work directly with other developers, designers, quality engineers, DevOps engineers and product owners to deliver the best platform for our users. This is a full stack role with TypeScript and Node.js at its core. Most of your time goes into backend services, APIs and data models, and you are just as comfortable picking up a Vue.js frontend task when the feature needs it. You don’t hand work over a wall between backend and frontend: you take a feature from the data model to the screen. AI is part of how we build and part of what we build. You use AI coding assistants and agents in your daily work, and you help shape how AI-powered capabilities reach our product. We want people who embrace it, measure what it gives us, and stay in charge of the quality of what ships. The team works with strong goals and a good balance of product and engineering roadmap work, so we keep both our technology and our product on track.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and ship robust backend services and frontends with real product impact
  • Ensure systems are scalable, performant and easy to maintain
  • Model business domains into clean, performant data structures
  • Collaborate across teams to integrate services and deliver end-to-end value
  • Coach and mentor other engineers on best practices to help them grow
  • Collaborate with other engineers and lead technical delivery on initiatives within a domain or project
  • Lead by example in engineering excellence, pragmatism and shared ownership

Requirements

What we’re looking for

Must have:

  • 5+ years of hands-on, production experience delivering full-stack products with TypeScript and JavaScript, with Node.js as your main backend
  • A positive attitude to AI, backed by experience: you already use AI tools and agents in your daily work, and you want to push the team further with them. If you are sceptical of AI, or would rather protect your team from it, this isn’t the right job for you.

Core:

  • Hands-on experience with Vue.js (or another modern frontend framework), and no fear of working in the frontend
  • Solid experience designing and integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Proficiency in data modeling and working with SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Comfortable working in monorepo environments and modular architectures
  • Familiar with testing practices, performance tuning and scalable design principles
  • Confident in making architectural decisions and communicating trade-offs
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • You are proactive, result-driven, and excited to work in a fast-growing tech scale-up

What makes you senior for this role:

  • You own outcomes, not just tasks, and see work through from problem to production.
  • You make the architectural calls in your domain and explain the trade-offs clearly.
  • You make the people around you better through reviews, mentoring and the standards you set.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with PHP (Laravel). Part of our platform runs on it, but it is not what this job is about
  • Experience building features on top of LLMs or other AI services
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD, DevOps and public cloud (like GCP)

We Value Diversity:
We champion and welcome diversity in our workforce and ensure all job applicants receive equal and fair treatment, regardless of age, race, gender or gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or nationality. 

We are not only committed to increasing the visibility and recognition of talent from under-represented groups within our organisation but the wider industry too.

Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

  • Collaborating with engineering, design, and research teams to translate insights into hypotheses, experiments, and features that delight users and grow Doctolib Connect's network

  • Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leadership to ensure solutions serve users and meet business needs across target markets

Who you are

Are you convinced that you have exactly what it takes for the position? Then we encourage you to apply. Even if you don't meet every requirement, you might be exactly the right future Doctoliber for this or other positions!

You could be our next team mate if you:

About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're hiring Senior Product Designers for Credit & Cards (credit application, card issuance, and repayment experiences used by real businesses managing real money). You'll own design from discovery through delivery, turning complex financial workflows into experiences that are simple, trustworthy, and easy to act on — working closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Research.

  • Contribute to the design system, improving consistency, accessibility, and craft across the interface.
  • Design credit application, card issuance, and repayment experiences that build trust in complex financial decisions.
  • Translate compliance and risk requirements (credit checks, KYC, repayment terms) into clear, honest, usable flows.
  • Balance conversion goals with responsible communication of risk and cost to the customer.

    • Who You Are
  • 4+ years of experience in product design, with ownership of complex, multi-step user flows.
  • A strong portfolio showing user-centered thinking and polished interaction/visual craft.

  • Fluent professional English

    • Nice to Have
  • Fintech, SaaS, or other regulated/complex-industry experience (not required — a plus).
  • Prior experience with lending, payments, or KYC/compliance flows.
  • Regular use of AI tools (e.g. prototyping, research synthesis) in your workflow.

    • Hiring Process

  • Step 1: Async Portfolio Review — We review your portfolio link and one written response to assess craft and design quality before scheduling any calls.

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call — A video chat with VP of Design focusing on your ownership, drive, and collaborative style.

  • Step 3: Take-Home Assignment — A practical Finom product case study (3–5 days turnaround) evaluated for strategic thinking, user insights, and design execution.

  • Step 4: Live Presentation & Cross-Functional Interview — A full walkthrough and Q&A with design and product leads.

    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care
     
    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

    At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. Jouw impact als Senior Social & AI Marketeer

Als Senior Social & AI Marketeer bij Indicia ben je het strategische aanspreekpunt voor grote klanten en vertaal je hun commerciële doelstellingen naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën. Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast signaleer je proactief commerciële kansen bij klanten en deel je jouw kennis en ervaring met junior marketeers. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan het succes van klanten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team en de dienstverlening van Indicia.

Over Indicia

Indicia is een onafhankelijk tech, data en AI-bureau dat sinds 1996 organisaties helpt om digitaal te groeien. Vanuit de overtuiging dat succesvolle digitale oplossingen beginnen bij een goed begrip van de business, combineert Indicia technologie, data en ondernemerschap om organisaties verder te brengen.

Met ruim 250 digitale specialisten biedt Indicia een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder online marketing, webdevelopment, HubSpot, AI en design. Van het ontwikkelen van websites en digitale platforms tot het realiseren van effectieve marketingcampagnes en slimme automatiseringen. Indicia bedient klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en richt zich steeds meer op grotere organisaties en langdurige samenwerkingen.

De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase van verdere professionalisering, waarbij de focus ligt op het verdiepen van specialismen, het versterken van de strategische klantrelaties en het realiseren van meetbare resultaten. AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Indicia ontwikkelt eigen AI-tools om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten, waardoor meer ruimte ontstaat voor strategisch advies, innovatie en klantontwikkeling.

De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, familiair en ondernemend. Collega's werken nauw samen, krijgen veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en worden gestimuleerd om zich zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de ambitie om resultaatgerichter te werken en als organisatie verder te professionaliseren.

https://www.indicia.ai/

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en presenteren van socialmediastrategieën voor grote klanten, waarbij je commerciële doelstellingen vertaalt naar concrete campagnes en meetbare resultaten;
  • Actief bijdragen aan commerciële voorstellen, pitches en pre-salesgesprekken, waarbij je klanten adviseert over de mogelijkheden van social advertising;
  • Fungeren als strategisch en inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, waarbij je periodiek campagneresultaten presenteert en proactief kansen voor upsell en cross-sell signaleert;
  • Zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van paid social campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok, inclusief het bewaken van instellingen, KPI's en budgetten;
  • Analyseren van campagneresultaten, uitvoeren van A/B-testen en continu verbeteren van performance, conversies en rendement;
  • Samenwerken met het interne AI-lab om AI en automatisering slim toe te passen binnen campagnes, contentcreatie, budgetoptimalisatie en werkprocessen;
  • Signaleren en toepassen van nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen social advertising en AI, waarbij je ook de verbinding legt met andere online marketingdisciplines, zoals SEO en SEA;
  • Coachen en begeleiden van junior social marketeers, kennis delen en bijdragen aan hun professionele ontwikkeling;
  • Aanbrengen van structuur, stimuleren van eigenaarschap en bewaken van de kwaliteit binnen het social team.

Jouw plek binnen de organisatie:

Als ervaren collega ben je een vraagbaak en sparringpartner voor de junior social marketeers. Je deelt je kennis over social en AI, en helpt hen zo verder te groeien. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Sophie Mees, Delivery Manager Online Marketing.

Requirements

Je bent een enthousiaste en ondernemende persoonlijkheid die energie brengt, initiatief neemt en het team weet mee te nemen in nieuwe ideeën. Je voelt je thuis in een informele en familiaire werkomgeving en draagt met jouw commerciële drive en resultaatgerichte instelling bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met paid social advertising, bij voorkeur binnen een groter marketingbureau, waarbij je gewend bent te werken met aanzienlijke mediabudgetten;
  • Uitgebreide kennis van advertentieplatforms zoals Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok en ervaring met het zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van campagnes;
  • Een analytische instelling en aantoonbare ervaring met campagneanalyse, A/B-testen en performanceoptimalisatie;
  • Een sterke strategische en commerciële blik, waarbij je businessdoelstellingen vertaalt naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën en kansen voor klantgroei signaleert;
  • Ervaring als strategisch gesprekspartner voor klanten op management- en directieniveau, gecombineerd met sterke communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden;
  • Een AI-minded en tech-savvy instelling, waarbij je AI actief inzet voor contentontwikkeling, campagneoptimalisatie en het automatiseren van werkprocessen;
  • Ervaring met het coachen en begeleiden van junior collega's en het delen van vakinhoudelijke kennis; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Benefits

Bij Indicia kom je terecht in een informele en ambitieuze werkomgeving waar je de vrijheid krijgt om initiatief te nemen en écht impact te maken. Je werkt voor aansprekende klanten, krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-tools en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de dienstverlening.

René de Boer

Jouw impact bij Movares

Jij zorgt dat de expertise van Movares niet alleen wordt gezien, maar ook leidt tot een sterkere marktpositie, hechtere klantrelaties en nieuwe opdrachten.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Jij bent strategisch businesspartner voor directies en businessverantwoordelijken binnen verschillende marktunits.

  • Jij vertaalt markt- en businessdoelstellingen naar scherpe marketingcommunicatiestrategieën en concrete, resultaatgerichte aanpakken.

Als senior marketingcommunicatieadviseur verbind je de ambities van de business met de positionering van Movares. Je initieert en regisseert de ontwikkeling van proposities, campagnes, casestudies, standpunten en events rond thema’s als Leefomgeving, Energie, Infrastructuur en Bereikbaarheid. Daarbij stel je prioriteiten, bewaak je de samenhang en stuur je collega’s en externe partners projectmatig aan. Je houdt regie op de marketingcommunicatieaanpak en het resultaat, waarbij je de specialistische uitvoering bij collega's en externe partners legt.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een stevige en resultaatgerichte adviseur die snel tot de kern komt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen directie, inhoudelijke experts en uitvoerende partners, brengt focus in uiteenlopende belangen en durft richting te geven. Daarbij combineer je strategisch inzicht met commerciële scherpte en daadkracht.

Dit breng je ook mee: 

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in marketing of marketingcommunicatie;

  • ruime ervaring in een strategische marketing-communicatierol. Bij voorkeur in een zakelijke of kennisintensieve B2B-omgeving;

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen. 

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 6.500 en € 7.500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met overtuigende adviesvaardigheden. Je bent klantgericht, pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht en weet complexe normering begrijpelijk uit te leggen zonder de technische nauwkeurigheid te verliezen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je projecten, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en durft richting te geven aan klanten en collega’s.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in elektrotechniek, technische natuurkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting;

  • ruime relevante werkervaring, bij voorkeur circa tien jaar, met EMC, elektromagnetische beïnvloeding, hoogspanningssystemen of een aanverwant specialistisch vakgebied;

  • ervaring met technisch advies, projectmatig werken en het vertalen van normen en onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete maatregelen;

  • ervaring met GIS applicaties en programmeren in MATLAB of Python is een pré;

  • kennis van de NEN3654:2023 en RLN00398 is een pré.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen €6.250 en €7.250 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

De afdeling Energie is een gezellige en sociale club van ongeveer 50 collega’s. Regelmatig organiseren we gezellige teamuitjes, organiseren we uitdagende kennissessies en zijn we aanwezig op leerzame events! Als onderdeel van team Energie sta je midden in de energietransitie. Samen met je collega’s benader je deze enorme uitdaging procesmatig en vanuit de inhoud. Door een zeer professionele way of working kom je met elkaar tot creatieve en toekomstbestendige adviezen én ontwerpen die we aanbieden aan opdrachtgevers als TenneT, Stedin, ProRail, Provincies, Ministeries en Rijkswaterstaat. De afdeling Energie focust zich op duurzame energievoorziening, rail energiesystemen en EMC & netkwaliteit.

Movares is zeer ervaren en groot genoeg om succesvol te zijn in de meest uitdagende projecten van het land. Deze uitdagingen ga jij vanuit afdeling Energie aan binnen een informele organisatie met korte lijnen. Jij en je collega’s zijn zeer betrokken bij het werk. Samen met hen voer jij projecten uit in het werkveld Energie, voor ‘onze’ opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast werk je met teams van andere afdelingen samen aan multidisciplinaire projecten. Zo proef je verschillende werkvelden en leer je van adviseurs en engineers in meerdere disciplines. Jouw ontwikkeling gaat altijd door!

Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).

  • Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).

  • Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging.

  • Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

We’re on the search for...

Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it.

In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other.

The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp.

This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline.

The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

You’ll be:

  • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

  • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

  • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

  • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

  • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

  • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

  • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

  • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.

 

Your profile

  • 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.
  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

 

What's in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with Wellhub.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. 
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

📍Location: Amsterdam

⏱ Weekly Hours: Between 16 -30 hours per week

📅 Start Date & Duration: Available immediately (6-month minimum commitment)

Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution! Since 2012, Fastned has been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations powered entirely by solar and wind energy — now spanning over 400 stations across nine countries in Europe. Our goal is 1,000 stations in prime locations.

About the role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Working Student with a strong passion for data, analytics and procurement . In this role, you will play a key part and help build the foundations of Procurement at Fastned.

In this role, you will be part of the Procurement Team, reporting to the Head of Procurement and collaborating closely with the Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams spanning Construction, Operations, Technology & Engineering, and IT.

Procurement at Fastned is designed to support the business, not constrain it. The Procurement function does not make unilateral decisions about supplier or product selection. Instead, it brings structure, market insight, commercial expertise and oversight. You will help put this approach into practice.

What you’ll be doing

  • Dive into our supplier and purchasing data to uncover spending patterns, spot smart consolidation opportunities, and identify potential savings.

  • Research market developments, map out supplier landscapes, and benchmark pricing and services across Fastned’s key procurement categories.

  • Help set the team up for success in commercial negotiations by preparing clear supplier profiles, spend insights, and negotiation briefs.

  • Keep track of how our suppliers are performing across cost, quality, delivery, and ESG—helping prepare supplier reviews and following up on agreed next steps.

  • Help build and maintain practical procurement templates, guidelines, and sourcing documentation that make buying at Fastned smooth and transparent.

  • Support our Procurement Champions across different teams by sharing handy tools, templates, and everyday guidance.

  • Coordinate meetings and workshops with internal teams and suppliers, making sure decisions and follow-up actions are clearly captured.

Who we are looking for

  • You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme (ideally in Business, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field) with a genuine interest in procurement, supplier management, or commercial negotiations.

  • You enjoy diving into data, spreadsheets, and complex information to turn them into clear, actionable insights. You’re confident with Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with data visualisation or procurement tools is a great plus.

  • You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and work well independently, while handling sensitive commercial and financial information with discretion.

  • You communicate clearly and enjoy partnering with stakeholders across different teams and backgrounds.

  • Fluency in English is essential, and any additional European language is a bonus.

  • You’re excited about Fastned’s mission and eager to play an active part in accelerating the energy transition.

What you’ll learn

In this role, you will gain practical experience in:

  • Procurement category management and strategic sourcing

  • Supplier and contract management

  • Spend analysis, RFP and tender processes

  • Commercial negotiations

  • Procurement governance and stakeholder management

  • Building a new Procurement function in a fast-growing international company


What you get out of it

Beyond a meaningful working student role at a company actively accelerating Europe's energy transition, here's what we offer:

  • Flexibility that fits your schedule. We'll coordinate your working hours around your studies, no forced trade-offs between work and university.

  • Daily lunches, snacks and drinks at our Amsterdam office.

  • Break a sweat and improve your well-being with our Urban Sports Club Subscription and additional weekly fitness classes (kickboxing & bootcamp) led by professional trainers.

  • Mental Wellbeing with nilo health: Access to a confidential mental health platform offering 1-on-1 coaching with psychologists, group sessions, and a variety of digital self-care tools.

  • Real responsibility from day one. At Fastned, we don't believe in busywork. We want you to think like a founder! Your input matters, and you'll be expected to take ownership. Your analyses will influence where Fastned builds next.

  • An hourly salary of €16,25 gross (+ holiday pay).

Apply today!

We would love to hear from you! Send us your CV along with a short motivation explaining why you're excited about joining our mission.

Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique.

Actieve sourcing en hunting

Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change.

Procesverbetering en data

Talentpools

Je bouwt aan talentpools voor commerciële en specialistische functies, zodat we ook op de lange termijn succesvol kunnen blijven werven.

Eerlijk – Je communiceert open, duidelijk en betrouwbaar. 
Beweging – Je pakt aan, denkt vooruit en brengt energie in elk project.

Do you enjoy helping engineering teams grow while keeping a close eye on technical quality? Are you a servant leader who leads through influence rather than authority? Then you could be the Engineering Lead we're looking for.

As Engineering Lead, you'll lead and coach three back-office engineering teams in our connectivity domain. Each team has about three developers, plus outsourced developers. You'll make sure the teams deliver predictably and to a high technical standard, that people keep growing, and that the work stays aligned with product goals. You'll be part of a group of six Engineering Leads, working together on team effectiveness, technical improvements and tech alignment across teams.

Location: Sunweb Group office in Rotterdam (Hybrid)
Start Date: Asap

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead, coach and develop three engineering teams, and build high-performing teams with a growth and blameless mindset

  • Ensure predictable delivery while balancing speed with sustainable engineering practices

  • Drive technical improvements and engineering excellence, and promote software best practices

  • Simplify complex technical solutions and help teams make sound technical decisions

  • Guide teams through change and build a culture of continuous improvement

  • Align multiple stakeholders across business and technology, and drive tech alignment on cross-team initiatives

  • Work with external technology partners and suppliers when needed

Who you'll work with

You'll work closely with other Engineering Leads, Software Engineers, Architects and Product Owners. You'll also work with technicall stakeholders from Hotels, Transport, Ancillaries and Purchasing.

Who you are

You're a servant leader with strong people skills, technical curiosity and high quality standards, and you take a pragmatic approach. You work independently, take ownership and stay resilient when you meet resistance. You hold teams accountable, balance business and technical needs, and are always looking for the next step to improve.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Fluency in English

  • Dutch and/or Spanish is a big plus

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams, and you're comfortable managing several teams at once

  • Experience working with cross-functional product teams and with Product and Architecture stakeholders

  • Strong skills in people leadership, coaching, stakeholder management and Agile delivery

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, plus experience with change management

  • A lean approach to problem solving and decision making

    • CI/CD, DevOps and software delivery practices

    • Software quality, observability, security and operational excellence

    • AI-assisted development tools that improve engineering productivity

    • Lean software craftsmanship and continuous improvement

Your toolbox

Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD tooling, observability and monitoring platforms, and collaboration and documentation tools.

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Senior Platform Engineer
We are looking for a passionate and collaborative Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Core team. At Treatwell we follow Team Topologies principles: our platform exists to enable stream-aligned teams to move faster and more autonomously, through self-service capabilities, reliable infrastructure and a great developer experience, built in partnership with our Developer Experience and Data Platform teams.

The Platform Core team provides the foundational infrastructure and tooling that enables Treatwell's engineering organisation to ship value quickly and safely. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will own the ambiguous platform problems nobody has scoped yet. You will shape them with the team before they become work, design solutions at service level and make the technical calls in your domain. 

We want product teams to experience Platform Core as a strategic partner: a trusted advisor involved early, not a ticket resolver. We deliver value in small increments, own outcomes together with the teams we support, and measure success by the impact we enable across Engineering

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning core platform capabilities (AWS and GCP foundations, identity and access, networking and the AI layer on Bedrock), from ambiguous problems to production, delivered in small slices.
  • Design delivery and operation of our EKS platform in partnership with DevX, including upgrades, add-ons and autoscaling.
  • Building self-service tooling, such as OpenTofu pipelines and GitLab CI/CD components, so teams can provision infrastructure themselves.
  • Running GitLab and other shared platform services: upgrades, patching, monitoring and recovery.
  • Making sure every platform change goes through a reviewed pipeline.
  • Making and owning the technical decisions in your domain, using spikes to test options and escalating early when needed.
  • Commanding platform incidents, and following through on post-mortems.
  • Improving the security of the services you own, in line with the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
  • Using AI tools in your daily work and helping others do the same.
  • Mentoring engineers, giving useful feedback.
  • Shaping engineering standards through our guilds
  • Partnering with product teams early, understanding their plans before they need us, and making Platform Core easy to work with.
  • Aligning teams on approach before work starts, and explaining trade-offs in terms of risk and value.
  • Using platform metrics and support data to argue for what to do next, and shaping new work with your team before it is defined

About you

  • Several years in platform, infrastructure, with clear ownership of production platforms used by other engineering teams.
  • Deep hands-on Terraform (or OpenTofu) on AWS, including module design and multi-account or multi-tenant setups.
  • Expert with Kubernetes (EKS) and containers; experience running cluster upgrades and Helm or Kustomize at scale.
  • Strong in GitLab CI and designing reusable pipelines and templates for many teams.
  • Professional depth in core AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS, EKS). GCP exposure is a bonus.
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, modern cloud networking such as AWS VPC Lattice and service mesh with support for identity-based access between services
  • Fluent in Bash and Python for automation; comfortable on Linux 
  • Practical observability experience with Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Grafana, including defining SLIs and alerting.
  • Security-minded: IAM least privilege, secrets management, container supply-chain security, and applying the AWS Well-Architected Framework and DSOMM.
  • Experience leading production incidents and making technical decisions you own, including when they turn out wrong.
  • Have grown other engineers and can explain complex trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

We’ll treat you with:

  • 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays
  • Monthly £/€40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too
  • Market-specific benefits that will be discussed in the interview process

Equal Opportunities

Treatwell is an 'Open to All' employer and warmly welcomes everybody to the team. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process as required. Please add any adjustment requests to your application.
